item.title: Chaining Deep Link Injection with SQLi to Leak Sensitive Data from an iOS App
item.description: Chaining deep link URL scheme handling with SQL injection in an iOS crypto wallet app to extract another user's recovery key via a UNION-based query.

item.title: Defeating Multi-Layer Anti-Reversing Protections on iOS with Static Analysis and Frida
item.description: Bypassing a multi-layered RASP/compliance check system in Captain NoHook using static analysis with r2/nm to locate functions, Frida to replace them, and Objection to find the hidden flag in memory.

item.title: One Hook to Bypass All: Defeating iOS Jailbreak Detection with Frida
item.description: Bypassing iOS jailbreak detection in No Escape by hooking the root isJailbroken() export with Frida, then using Objection to find the flag in memory.
